Small quality-gate fix round for the cli-odi-entity-parity feature branch. Two mechanical fixes to already-committed code. Do EXACTLY this; nothing else.

You are in the `agentic-odi` uv workspace at /home/alexa/repos/agentic-odi, on branch `feature/cli-odi-entity-parity`. Do NOT switch branches, do NOT touch any other file.

## Fix 1 — core mypy error in the factory (Task 4 artifact)

`uv run --directory core mypy .` currently fails:
`src/core/factory.py:15: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "str | None", variable has type "str")  [assignment]`

Cause: in `core/src/core/factory.py`, mypy infers `resolved: str` from `resolved = db_path`, then line 15 assigns `os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_DB")` (`str | None`).

Fix: make the variable explicitly optional WITHOUT changing runtime behavior. Rewrite the resolution so it is:
```python
def build_repository(db_path: str | None = None) -> Repository:
    resolved: str | None
    if db_path is not None:
        resolved = db_path
    else:
        resolved = os.environ.get("AGENTIC_ODI_DB")
    if resolved is None:
        resolved = os.path.expanduser("~/.agentic-odi/odi.db")
    if resolved == ":memory:":
        return InMemoryRepository()
    parent = os.path.dirname(resolved)
    if parent:
        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
    return SQLiteRepository(db_path=resolved)
```
Confirm `uv run --directory core mypy .` prints `Success` and `uv run --directory core pytest` is green.
Commit 1: `git add core/src/core/factory.py` then
`git commit -m "fix(core): annotate resolved as optional in build_repository to satisfy mypy"`

## Fix 2 — format the parity test (Task 5 artifact)

`uv run ruff format --check mcp_server/tests/test_parity.py` reports it would be reformatted (the brief-supplied lines were transcribed verbatim but exceed line length/flow). Run:
`uv run ruff format mcp_server/tests/test_parity.py`
This must only reflow code, never change semantics or assertions. Then confirm `uv run --directory mcp_server pytest -v` is green and `uv run ruff format --check mcp_server/tests/test_parity.py` says it is already formatted.
Commit 2: `git add mcp_server/tests/test_parity.py` then
`git commit -m "style(mcp): apply ruff format to parity tests"`

- Do not reformat or modify `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-16-first-run-onboarding.md` (an unrelated untracked doc from another workstream).
- Do not change any other file.
